provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address data and actual copy excluded; vertical retained; copy structure only.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A tall double-sided primary monument (Master Sign Program standard): a fabricated aluminum cabinet with push-through white acrylic copy and tiered stepped-inset side accents (painted + internally lit acrylic), set at a landscape masonry wall on an engineered steel support.
knowledge.rationale: Push-through acrylic gives crisp lit copy on an opaque field; the stepped-inset side profile adds sculptural depth to a campus identity monument.

structure.construction: fabricated aluminum cabinet with internal structural frame (P1 Onyx), push-through 1/2in-proud white acrylic #7328, internal LED, removable face/back panels with stainless socket-drive screws
painted P3 inset 1in, internally-illuminated acrylic accent with first-surface translucent vinyl inset 2in, painted P8 inset 3in
set at landscape masonry wall (by others); steel support per sign engineer; concrete M3

materials_manifest.product: Matthews Onyx / Angora Grey / Designer White palette

compliance.notes: NEC Article 600 grounding/bonding; local sign-area analysis (<=1 sqft/linear ft frontage, max 200 sqft).

craft_observations: Push-through acrylic = crisp lit copy on opaque field.
Stepped-inset side tiers add sculptural depth.
